common.appTagline: Import your contacts, see every deal on one board, and never forget a follow-up.

search.title: Search
search.description: Find a contact, company or deal.

filters.saveViewHint: Saves the current filters under a name, just for you.

home.eyebrow: A small CRM for small German teams
home.heading: Import your contacts. See every deal. Never miss a follow-up.
home.body: Contacts and companies, a Kanban pipeline with weighted forecasting, CSV import with duplicate detection, an activity feed and automatic follow-up tasks. Hosted in Frankfurt, no third-party trackers.

auth.signUpSubtitle: Two minutes and you have a working CRM.
auth.forgotSubtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
auth.resetSubtitle: Pick something you have not used elsewhere.
auth.confirmationSent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish signing up.
auth.magicLinkSent: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way.

onboarding.title: Create your organization
onboarding.subtitle: Everything in the CRM belongs to an organization. You can invite your colleagues once it exists.
onboarding.localeHint: Sets the language of content we create for you, such as pipeline stage names. Each person can still choose their own interface language.

organization.settingsSubtitle: Name, language and formatting defaults for everyone in this workspace.
organization.currencyHint: Three-letter ISO code, for example EUR or CHF.
organization.adminOnly: Only admins and owners can change these settings.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: People with access to this organization.
members.inviteSubtitle: We generate a one-time link. Send it to them yourself — by email, chat, however you like.
members.linkExplainer: Copy this now. It is shown once and cannot be recovered — only a hash is stored. It expires in 7 days and only works for {email}.
members.roleOwnerHint: Full control, including billing and deleting the organization.
members.roleAdminHint: Manage members and all data. No billing access.
members.roleMemberHint: Work with all data. Cannot manage members.
members.memberOnlyView: Only admins and owners can manage members.

invite.title: Join {organization}
invite.subtitle: You have been invited to collaborate.
invite.signInFirstBody: This invitation is tied to a specific email address. Sign in or create an account with that address, then open the link again.
invite.invalidBody: It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask whoever invited you for a fresh link.
invite.wrongEmailBody: This invitation was issued for a different email address. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.

import.title: Import contacts
import.uploadSubtitle: A CSV export from your old CRM, Excel, or Google Sheets.
import.uploadHint: Up to 10 MB and 20,000 rows. Comma, semicolon or tab separated — we work it out.
import.templatePrompt: Not sure how to lay out your file?
import.templateHint: Only a name or an email address is required — every other column is optional, and you can leave out columns you do not have.
import.raggedRows: {count, plural, one {# row has} other {# rows have}} the wrong number of columns and may be misread — check rows {rows}. This usually means a quote is not closed.
import.previewSubtitle: Nothing has been written yet. The first 20 rows are shown below.
import.policyHint_skip: The existing contact is left exactly as it is.
import.policyHint_update: Filled-in cells overwrite existing values. Blank cells never erase anything.
import.policyHint_create: Email addresses must be unique, so matching contacts are skipped rather than duplicated.
import.createCompaniesLabel: Create companies that do not exist yet
import.noTasksNote: No follow-up tasks are created by an import. You can add them once tasks arrive in Phase 6.
import.startImport: Import {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
import.runningSubtitle: Keep this tab open until it finishes.
import.doneSubtitle: You can undo this run from the history below.
import.confirmUndo: Delete the {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}} this import created? Contacts it merely updated keep their new values — those cannot be restored.

companies.emptyBody: Companies are a first-class object here. Add one, or let CSV import create them from contact email domains in Phase 3.
companies.noMatchesBody: Try a different search term or clear the filters.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.emptyBody: Add your first deal to see it on the board. Cards can be dragged between stages, and each column shows its total and weighted value.
pipeline.setupFailed: The default pipeline could not be created. Reload the page, and let us know if it keeps happening.
pipeline.newSubtitle: Only a title and a stage are required.
pipeline.confirmDelete: Delete this deal? This cannot be undone.
pipeline.valueHint: Type it however you like — 12500, 12.500 or 12,500.00 all work.
pipeline.openDeals: {count, plural, =0 {No open deals} one {# open deal} other {# open deals}}
pipeline.moreCards: {count, plural, one {# more deal} other {# more deals}} in this stage
pipeline.daysInStage: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} here
pipeline.daysInStageLong: {days, plural, =0 {Moved here today} one {# day in this stage} other {# days in this stage}}
pipeline.a11yPickedUp: Picked up {title}. Use the arrow keys to move it, space to drop.
pipeline.lostSubtitle: Optional, but this is the only moment anyone remembers. It is what makes a loss report worth building later.
pipeline.lostReasonPlaceholder: Price, timing, went with a competitor…
pipeline.stagesIntro: Stages belong to your organization — rename them to match how you actually sell. The probability drives the weighted pipeline value, which is the figure that predicts revenue rather than just adding deals up.
pipeline.stageDealCount: {count, plural, =0 {no deals} one {# deal} other {# deals}}

automation.settingsSubtitle: Rules that create work for the team automatically.
automation.leadTaskEnabledHint: When a deal is created in the first stage of a pipeline, create a follow-up task for its owner.
automation.leadTaskTitleHint: Stored as you type it and never re-translated. Use {'{{'}contact_name{'}}'}, {'{{'}company_name{'}}'} or {'{{'}deal_title{'}}'} to fill in details.
automation.leadTaskOffsetDaysHint: Set at 09:00 in the organization's timezone, skipping weekends.
automation.adminOnly: Only admins and owners can change automation.
automation.missing: This organization has no automation settings, so no tasks are created automatically.

settings.profileSubtitle: How you appear to teammates, and which language the interface uses for you.
settings.emailReadOnly: Your sign-in address cannot be changed here yet.

billing.noSubscriptionRow: This organization has no billing record yet.

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.subtitle: Export everything this workspace holds, or delete it for good. Both are self-serve, which is what the DSGVO asks for.
privacy.exportBody: A complete copy of this organization: contacts, companies, deals, activities, tasks and import history. The JSON file keeps every field; the CSV files are for spreadsheets.
privacy.exportNote: Very large workspaces are capped at 20,000 rows per collection. The JSON file reports the true totals so you can tell whether anything was cut.
privacy.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can export a workspace.
privacy.subprocessorsBody: The complete list of companies that process data on our behalf. All hosting is in the EU.
privacy.dangerBody: Deletes this organization and everything inside it — contacts, companies, deals, activities, tasks and import history. Nothing survives. Export first.
privacy.graceNote: Deletion is scheduled {days} days out, so a mistake is still recoverable until then.
privacy.ownerOnly: Only an owner can delete an organization.
privacy.dialogBody: Everything in {name} is deleted after {days} days. You can cancel from this page until then, but not afterwards.
privacy.confirmLabel: Type the organization's name to confirm
privacy.pendingBody: {name} and everything in it will be deleted on {date}.
privacy.pendingBanner: This workspace is scheduled for deletion on {date}.
